nom: Vichy Neovadiol GF Night Cream, 1.7 fl. oz.

avis.texte: It is rare that I can see significant improvement from skin care products. I have been using Retin-A for years so my skin is in pretty good condition. This product, however, rates 5 stars, in my opinion, because it has definitely improved the sagging along my jaw line and the overall density of my skin. I get a lot of compliments on my skin, which is surprising at my age (69). I use this product as a moisturizer over the Retin-A, after it has absorbed - 10 to 15 minutes.

avis.texte: She asked for it, I bought it. She is so picky, if this wasn't a good product, she wouldn't ask for it. By the way a written review is a big pain in the ass, can't i just give 5 damn stars and be finished?

Despite it took almost three weeks to get it it was deliverd in a nice package and the jar was fine. I tried this face cream in Paris and loved it, and I also loved the price from Europa Unlimited. This is the best moisturizer for an aging and dry skin. I don't want to spend my money on face creams which have an "immediate absorbtion) because you wake up with a completely dry face, and that is because the cheap ingredients don't supply any moisture to your face. Vichy is a favorite and affordable product for many European women so, why not to join them? I recommend this cream and the supplier. You won't regret.
It feels good when I put it on at night. Doesn't dry my skin or cause breakouts.

avis.texte: I have other products in this line a "nothing special" rating but I LOVED this one. Skin is super soft, redness is calmed down in cheek area and my neck seems a bit firmer. Nice product, will buy it again.

avis.titre: This is a great night cream
avis.texte: This is a great night cream. It absorbs quickly and has a nice scent. The texture is light, creamy and moisturizing.

Amazing cream! Had moved to a cold weather, hard-water area and my skin was dry and irritated. This cream has transformed my face. Put it on at night and wake up to smooth, moisturized and firmer skin in the morning. Lines less noticeable, really dramatic results! Love it! Delivery took a bit of time as I am in the States but worth the wait.
I have been using this for a few years, recommended by dermatologists. The result is healthy-looking, well nourished and non-greasy skin.
